[NOTE] This game is currently in BETA so expect bugs! Please report any bugs or issues you find.

🗡️ Fight your way through waves of mobs in unique dungeons, collect drops and materials from mob drops to craft and increase your stats as you progress! Do you have what it takes to climb the leader boards and become the strongest fighter?

🗡️ Fight waves of enemies
🔨 Earn loot from drops and craft gear to help you improve your stats
🧙‍♂️ Unlock many abilities to help you in combat
🦸‍♂️ Unlock heroes to help you fight in battles
💪 Unlock upgrades to further improve your stats and equipment and help you grow stronger
